# Fiona McBride

HRIS project manager for the Talvento programme since 2025-09-01, on a fixed-term contract to 2027-03-31. Reports to [[adrian-fairclough]] as programme sponsor and writes every HRIS Steering Group paper.

## How we work together

- I support her on data and testing: the defect log, the parallel run differences log and the Steering Group action log. She gives clear deadlines and expects a count, not a story.
- She asked me to run the 312-record retest with [[rashid-karimi]] after the [[uat-defect-review-2026-03-11]], which is how I ended up knowing the absence conversion rules better than anyone outside payroll.
- She is direct about risk in writing and diplomatic in meetings. Worth reading her papers in full.

## Current threads

- Wants payroll to cut over in November if the October parallel run is clean: double keying is causing the backdated-change differences, and her contract ends before a January slip could be absorbed ([[when-should-payroll-cut-over-to-talvento]]).
- Cutover paper for the 2026-11-04 Steering Group.
- Staffora decommissioning plan ([[staffora-decommissioning-plan]]).
